'''Sabine's speeder bike''',<ref name="Sabine Databank" /> formerly '''Ezra's speeder bike''', was a [[614-AvA speeder bike]] first owned by the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]]<ref name="Ezra Speeder Databank" /> after he stole it from the [[Galactic Empire]] when it became surplus.<ref name="ECGSWG" /> He [[Painting|repainted]] the [[speeder bike]] in green and yellow to match his own tastes and better blend in with other drivers.<ref name="Ezra Speeder Databank" /> Previously Bridger had stolen already multiple other Imperial speeder bikes, but had crashed them usually soon after,<ref name="ECGSWG" /> including another 614-AvA.<ref name="Spark">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]''</ref> Following the [[Liberation of Lothal]] and the disappearance of Bridger, it came into the possession of [[Sabine Wren]], who approved of Bridger's paintjob.<ref name="Dawn">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> Wren modified the speeder for improved speed and maneuverability and repainted it in her own artistic style in dark-red, purple and yellow.<ref name="Sabine Databank" /> It  had standard steering.<ref name="Ezra Speeder Databank" />

==History==
[[File:Run Ezra Run.png|thumb|left|Ezra Bridger on his speeder bike pursued by an Imperial combat driver]]
During the [[Imperial Era]] in [[4 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{RebelsDate|113}}</ref> Bridger on his [[614-AvA speeder bike]] with his master [[Kanan Jarrus]] on [[Kanan's Joben T-85 speeder bike|his]] [[Joben T-85 speeder bike]] and [[Sabine Wren]] on a [[Undicur-class jumpspeeder|''Undicur''-class jumpspeeder]] were chased by [[Imperial combat driver]]s on [[614-AvA speeder bike]]s and an [[Imperial Troop Transport]] during their [[raid near Jalath]].<ref name="Call to Action" /> Later during the [[New Republic Era]] in [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Ahsoka date">{{AhsokaSeriesDate}}</ref> Wren used her bike to avoid a patrol of [[E-wing starfighter|E-wing escort fighters]], sent by [[Governor]] [[Ryder Azadi]], to get her back to the [[Spectres mural ceremony]].<ref name="Part One" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The speeder bike first appeared in "[[Call to Action]]", the thirteenth episode of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'',<ref name="Call to Action" /> released on [[February 2]], [[2015]].<ref name="Rebels Recon Vision of Hope">{{RebelsRecon|A4TDSeBYXzE|#1.11: Inside "Vision of Hope" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-vision-of-hope}}</ref> Concept art of the speeder bike chase for the episode was done by an uncredited artist.<Ref name="concept">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/call-to-action-concept-art-gallery|text="Call to Action" Concept Art Gallery}}</ref> It later reappeared in live-action in the [[Part One: Master and Apprentice|first episode]] of the [[2023]] TV series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]''.<ref name="Part One" />
